title: Name a value
summary: MATLAB: Name a value. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: A variable stores a value. A semicolon hides the automatic display of an assignment.

blocks.text: Use MATLAB. Paste one example into the Command Window, or save it as a .m script and run the script. A MATLAB licence may be required.
The assignment stores 3. disp shows the sum 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Without a semicolon MATLAB also shows the assignment result.
